source.citation: Ghia, U., Ghia, K.N., Shin, C.T. (1982). J. Comput. Phys. 48:387-411. Table I: u along vertical line through geometric center x=0.5, Re=1000.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the 2D cavity mesh (resolution adequacy proxy)
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Re=1000 needs finer wall-layer resolution than Re=100; 120x120 (=14400) is the realistic minimum. Hand-set.

max_non_orthogonality.description: Max mesh non-orthogonality angle (degrees) reported by checkMesh
max_non_orthogonality.T_good_source: OpenFOAM checkMesh advisory: <70 deg acceptable, <30 deg good. Uniform structured cavity mesh is trivially 0; threshold here catches grossly distorted hand-built meshes.

final_residual_p.description: Final residual of the pressure equation at end of simulation
final_residual_p.T_good_source: Hand-set; SIMPLE on cavity Re=1000 should reach 1e-5

u_centerline_y0p5.T_good_source: Tightened from 0.015→0.008 in v3: the previous 25%-relative tolerance let any Re=1000-ish run pass. Calibrate via mesh study.

u_min_along_x0p5.description: most-negative u along vertical centreline x=0.5
u_min_along_x0p5.T_good_source: Tightened from 0.04→0.025; ~6.5% tolerance on the deep vortex value. Hand-set.
